usage: 放鬆 can be used as a verb meaning 'to relax' or 'to loosen up,' like taking a break after work.
As a noun, 放鬆 refers to the state of relaxation or a relaxing activity.
You can say 我想放鬆 (I want to relax) to express the desire to rest or ease tension.
It’s common to use 放鬆 with 身體 (body) or 心情 (mood) to specify what you are relaxing.
放鬆 can also describe actions like 放鬆肌肉 (relax muscles) or 放鬆心情 (ease your mind).

examples.sentence: 我下班後鍾意去行街放鬆。

examples.meaning: I like to go shopping to relax after work.
